newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Italy economic growth aiding public finances-Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Italy economic growth aiding public finances-Fazio.

text.p: Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said the country's economic growth was helping improve its public finances but that budget consolidation must continue without damaging growth.

Fazio, speaking after a monthly meeting of central bankers here, said: "In Italy the problem is to join growth and investment recovery to solve unemployment problems where they are most acute with continuation of cleaning up public finances, which is not yet complete."
"If there is not growth then that can damage the process of cleaning up public finance process, and where there is growth, that helps the tidying up process," Fazio said.
Fazio referred also to European economies, saying they were growing with difficulty.
"Unemployment is the primary question. But inflation -- and this is the positive figure -- is under control everywhere," he said.
